title.zh: Equinix 新加坡 SG6 啟用，一期 8MW、全期規劃 20MW IT 容量
title.en: Equinix opens SG6 in Singapore with 8MW first phase and 20MW full-build IT design

summary.zh: Equinix 於 11 月 6 日正式啟用新加坡第六座 IBX 資料中心 SG6，第一期提供 8MW IT 容量及約 1,550 個機櫃，初期投資約 2.9 億美元。20MW 是全期建置後的目標容量，公司未公布第一期實際使用率。
summary.en: Equinix opened SG6, its sixth Singapore IBX data center, on November 6 with 8MW of phase-one IT capacity and approximately 1,550 cabinets, backed by an initial US$290 million investment. The 20MW figure represents full-build design capacity, with no first-phase utilization reported.

text.zh: SG6 採用液冷與高密度機房設計，涉及機櫃供電、配電、冷卻及營運監測。該場址依新加坡資料中心徵案制度建設；公司公布的設計 PUE 目標為 1.20，不能視為已實測成績。
text.en: SG6 uses liquid-cooling and high-density infrastructure involving rack power, distribution, thermal management and monitoring. The facility falls under Singapore's data-center capacity allocation framework, while its 1.20 PUE is a design target rather than a measured operating result.

text.zh: 公司公告第一期 8MW 與全期 20MW 採不同階段口徑，20MW 不能當作 11 月 6 日新增已上線負載。Equinix 預計 2027 年與新加坡國立大學設立共同創新設施，研究液冷、數位孿生與儲能；這是規劃中的合作。
text.en: Company figures distinguish 8MW in phase one from a 20MW complete-build target. Equinix also plans a 2027 joint innovation facility with the National University of Singapore focused on cooling, digital twins and battery storage; it is a future initiative.

text.zh: 實際簽約機櫃、客戶使用率、液冷系統運轉功率及後續擴建時程未揭露。
text.en: Contracted cabinets, actual utilization, running liquid-cooling load and remaining-phase timelines were not disclosed.

title.zh: 奇鋐越南子公司簽訂約 15.73 億元機電與配套工程合約
title.en: AVC's Vietnam unit signs about NT$1.573B in electrical and ancillary construction contracts

summary.zh: 奇鋐 11 月 6 日代越南子公司 AVC TECH. 公告兩筆機電及配套裝修工程合約，合計約 1.2586 兆越南盾，折合約新台幣 15.73 億元，用於生產及營運。這是新增工程合約，與先前公告的第五期土建工程應分別核對範圍。
summary.en: AVC disclosed two electrical and ancillary construction contracts for its Vietnam subsidiary on November 6 totaling approximately VND1.2586 trillion, or NT$1.573 billion, for production and operations. These are newly reported contracts and must be distinguished from earlier phase-five civil construction commitments.

text.zh: 奇鋐業務涵蓋伺服器散熱、液冷與其他熱管理零組件；越南製造設施的機電工程屬設備上線前的廠務支出，不能直接推導新增散熱模組量。
text.en: AVC supplies server thermal-management and liquid-cooling components. Electrical and construction work at a Vietnam manufacturing site is facility spending, which cannot establish additional delivered cooling-module volume.

text.zh: 其中一項合約約 7,494 億越南盾，另一項約 5,092 億越南盾，合計約 1.2586 兆越南盾。此前 9 月曾公告第五期土建及機電規劃，兩次公告的合約內容是否重疊仍須核對原始契約。
text.en: The two contracts total roughly VND749.4 billion and VND509.2 billion. Earlier September disclosures addressed phase-five civil and electromechanical works; whether the latest contracts overlap with earlier scope requires checking the original contracts.

text.zh: 新工程與既有第五期預算的重疊範圍、完工月份、液冷產線驗收與產能未公布。
text.en: Contract-scope overlap, completion month, liquid-cooling line acceptance and output capacity remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 緯穎決議向馬來西亞子公司現金增資 2 億美元，公告用途為營運資金
title.en: Wiwynn approves US$200M cash injection into Malaysian subsidiary for working capital

summary.zh: 緯穎 11 月 6 日公告，董事會決議讓 Wiwynn Technology Service Malaysia 辦理 2 億美元現金增資，預計由 100% 持股母公司認購。公告指出用途為充實營運資金，未列為新增機器設備或擴建產能支出。
summary.en: Wiwynn disclosed on November 6 that its wholly owned Wiwynn Technology Service Malaysia subsidiary approved a US$200 million cash capital increase, to be subscribed by the parent. The stated purpose is working capital, with no new machine order or incremental factory capacity specified.

text.zh: 緯穎供應資料中心伺服器與系統，馬來西亞業務涉及整機製造及組裝，對零組件、供電和測試製程有實際需求。增資決議與製造設備採購及產線上線屬不同財務事件。
text.en: Wiwynn supplies data-center servers and systems, with Malaysian manufacturing operations linked to components, power and system testing. A capital injection is a financing action distinct from equipment procurement or a new line reaching production.

text.zh: 公開資訊觀測站轉載公告列出增資總額 200,000 仟美元，每股面額 1 馬來西亞令吉，股數將依繳款日匯率換算。增資後持股仍為 100%，資金用途明列充實營運資金。
text.en: The reproduced material-information filing states US$200,000 thousand in proceeds, shares at MYR1 par value with share count determined by the payment-date FX rate. Parent ownership remains 100% and proceeds are designated working capital.

text.zh: 實際繳款日、換算股數、採購項目和馬來西亞產線新增產能未公告。
text.en: Payment date, final share count, procurement items and any Malaysian capacity change were not disclosed.

title.zh: 緯創 10 月營收 4,026.15 億元，表示美國投資計畫暫無變動
title.en: Wistron October sales reach NT$402.615B; US investment plan unchanged

summary.zh: 緯創 11 月 6 日公布 10 月合併營收約 4,026.15 億元，月增 5.7%、年增超過 117%，前 10 個月累計營收約 3.29 兆元。公司對中央社表示美國既定投資計畫沒有變動，未另外揭露 AI 伺服器 10 月實際出貨台數。
summary.en: Wistron reported October consolidated revenue of about NT$402.615 billion on November 6, up 5.7% month on month and more than 117% year on year, with ten-month sales near NT$3.29 trillion. It told CNA its existing US investment plan is unchanged; actual October AI-server unit shipments were not reported.

text.zh: 緯創的伺服器 ODM 與電子整機業務涵蓋機櫃、主機板、機構及電源模組整合，集團營收仍混合筆電等產品。不可將單月整體營收成長視為特定 GPU 機櫃出貨增幅。
text.en: Wistron's server ODM and system integration cover racks, mainboards, enclosures and power modules, alongside PCs. Consolidated monthly revenue growth is not an AI GPU rack shipment growth rate.

text.zh: 10 月筆電出貨 120 萬台，桌上型電腦 50 萬台，顯示器 85 萬台。公司表示第四季 AI 業務展望未改變，預期 11 月和 12 月表現優於 10 月；這是前瞻性說法。
text.en: Wistron reported 1.2 million notebook units, 500,000 desktop units and 850,000 displays for October. Management maintained an outlook for stronger AI-related activity in November and December, which is forward-looking rather than realized shipment data.

text.en: AI-server/rack revenue and units, US project procurement, and customer acceptance dates were not disclosed.

title.zh: 追蹤：美光與桃園工會 11 月 6 日調解未成，市府安排下一次會議
title.en: Follow-up: Micron and Taoyuan union hold talks without agreement; another session planned

summary.zh: 美光 11 月 6 日與桃園工會在桃園市政府安排下調解，當天尚未達成協議，市府已安排下次會議。美光重申已與台中工會達成協議，但沒有公布桃園新廠工程全面停工的確認資訊。
summary.en: Micron and its Taoyuan union met for mediation on November 6 without a settlement; the city government has scheduled another session. Micron reiterated its Taichung union agreement but released no confirmation of a complete stoppage at its Taoyuan new-build project.

text.zh: 美光台灣涉及 DRAM 記憶體晶圓製造，桃園新廠工程與台中既有營運的範圍不同。前一日外媒停工說法仍未由政府或公司提供相符的工程進度文件。
text.en: Micron's Taiwan business includes DRAM wafer production. A Taoyuan construction project is distinct from ongoing Taichung operations, and the prior day's reported stoppage remains without a verified project-work schedule.

text.zh: 中央社 11 月 6 日晚間引述美光回應，確認桃園市政府勞動局協助當天調解，並安排下次會議。報導未載明新一輪協商的具體日期或施工狀態變更。
text.en: CNA quoted Micron confirming mediation supported by Taoyuan's labor authority and another planned meeting. No date for that meeting or change in construction status was specified.

text.zh: 下一輪協商日期、桃園新廠實際施工範圍、設備進場與對記憶體出貨影響仍待公布。
text.en: The next meeting date, actual construction status, equipment move-in and shipment implications remain undisclosed.

ceoView.en: For wafer etch RF-power, metrology and process-equipment suppliers, the new disclosure establishes continuing mediation only. Tool move-in and acceptance need project-level evidence; negotiations cannot substantiate canceled orders or reduced memory output.

title.zh: 華新麗華決議投入 3,000 萬美元，規劃越南不銹鋼精密材料基地
title.en: Walsin approves US$30M to establish Vietnamese precision stainless-steel materials subsidiary

summary.zh: 華新麗華 11 月 6 日公告，董事會決議以 3,000 萬美元在越南設立持股 100% 的子公司，規劃作為不銹鋼精密製造材料生產基地。公告未列明廠址、廠房產能或設備採購細節，須待設立完成後進一步披露。
summary.en: Walsin announced on November 6 that its board approved US$30 million to form a wholly owned Vietnamese subsidiary for precision stainless-steel manufacturing materials. The release did not identify a site, production capacity or equipment procurement, with further details due after incorporation.

text.zh: 不銹鋼精密材料可供各種工業設備及製造用途；尚無直接證據表明此案已取得半導體、伺服器或資料中心個別客戶的資格認證。
text.en: Precision stainless-steel materials serve industrial manufacturing and equipment; no evidence establishes semiconductor, server or data-center customer qualification for this particular project.

text.zh: 本案屬 11 月 6 日董事會投資決議，3,000 萬美元為規劃投入資金。公司現有跨國生產據點與本次越南新法人仍須獨立辨識。
text.en: The US$30 million is a board-approved investment plan from November 6. The new entity is distinct from Walsin's existing international manufacturing facilities.

text.zh: 新公司設立時程、越南城市與廠址、材料規格、設備清單和投產日期未揭露。
text.en: Incorporation timing, city and factory address, product grades, equipment list and commissioning date were not provided.

title.zh: 台美簽署產業創新研發合作意向書，11 月 17 日啟動首波徵案
title.en: Taiwan and US sign industrial R&D cooperation letter; first call opens Nov 17

summary.zh: 經濟部與美國國家科學基金會於 11 月 6 日啟動台美產業創新研發合作平台，並簽署合作意向書，首波共同徵案將於 11 月 17 日開放至 2027 年 3 月 17 日。合作領域涵蓋半導體、光子、先進材料及潔淨能源，尚未公布獲選企業或量產成果。
summary.en: Taiwan's economic ministry and the US National Science Foundation launched an industry R&D cooperation platform on November 6. Applications are scheduled for November 17 through March 17, 2027, covering semiconductors, photonics, advanced materials and clean energy, with no awarded projects or production results yet.

text.zh: 計畫由工研院、東北大學及 MTM Venture Partners 等參與執行，目的是連接研發、原型、測試驗證與產業量產。簽署意向書屬合作制度啟動，不能視為商業訂單。
text.en: The initiative involves ITRI, Northeastern University and MTM Venture Partners to connect R&D with prototypes and production validation. A cooperation letter establishes a framework rather than a commercial order.

text.zh: 經濟部表示 NSF 透過美國東北大學與台灣、日本、南韓、新加坡推動徵案，四方合計預計補助 16 案。台方補助最高為總研發經費 50%，美方新創公司每案最高 25 萬美元；兩項是補助上限。
text.en: The ministry says NSF's regional collaboration via Northeastern University involves Taiwan, Japan, South Korea and Singapore, with 16 projects anticipated across the arrangement. Taiwan-side funding may cover up to 50% of eligible R&D budgets and US startups up to US$250,000 per project; both are ceilings.

text.zh: 徵案審查結果、各案半導體技術驗證、實際補助額與量產成果未公布。
text.en: Selection outcomes, semiconductor qualification milestones, actual grants and production achievements remain unknown.

title.zh: 創見表示第四季 DRAM 與 NAND 報價趨於持平，第三季淨利季減 41.8%
title.en: Transcend expects steadier Q4 DRAM and NAND pricing after Q3 profit decline

summary.zh: 創見董事長 11 月 6 日表示，預期第四季 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 報價大致持平，創見營運表現估與第三季相近。公司第三季稅後淨利為新台幣 69.2 億元、季減 41.8%，報價與未來缺貨程度均屬公司判斷，未公布供應商合約價格。
summary.en: Transcend's chairman said on November 6 that DRAM and NAND flash prices should be broadly steady in Q4 and the company's operations roughly flat versus Q3. Q3 after-tax profit was NT$6.92 billion, down 41.8% sequentially; pricing and potential shortages are management assessments, not published supplier contract prices.

text.zh: 創見供應記憶體模組與儲存產品，DRAM、NAND 及 HBM 市場的供需條件各異。公司指出原料採購成本上升壓縮第三季獲利，不能單憑模組價格推估 HBM 產能。
text.en: Transcend sells memory modules and storage products, while DRAM, NAND and HBM have different supply dynamics. Management attributed Q3 margin pressure partly to rising input costs; module pricing does not quantify HBM capacity.

text.zh: 公司公布第三季每股純益 16.11 元，前 3 季稅後淨利約 269.4 億元、每股純益 62.74 元。董事長預期明年上半年 DRAM 可能更吃緊，應標示為前瞻性判斷。
text.en: The company reported Q3 EPS of NT$16.11 and nine-month net income of about NT$26.94 billion with EPS of NT$62.74. Management's expectation of tighter DRAM supply in first-half 2027 remains forward-looking.

text.zh: DRAM 與 NAND 分別採購均價、供應商分配額度及下一季實際出貨量未揭露。
text.en: Separate DRAM and NAND purchase prices, supplier allocations and next-quarter shipments were not disclosed.

title.zh: 佳世達 11 月 6 日決議對越南子公司增資 1,000 萬美元，供興建計畫使用
title.en: Qisda approves US$10M injection into Vietnam property subsidiary for construction

summary.zh: 佳世達 11 月 6 日決議增資 100% 持有的 Qisda Property Vietnam 子公司 1,000 萬美元，公告目的為支應興建計畫資金需求。公司未公開新建案的廠址、用途細節與設備清單，無法直接視為新增電子產品產能。
summary.en: Qisda approved a US$10 million capital injection into wholly owned Qisda Property Vietnam on November 6, citing funding needs for a construction project. The announcement did not specify the construction site, equipment or product capacity.

text.zh: 佳世達經營電子產品及醫療與企業解決方案，子公司的興建資金與電子產品量產線驗收屬不同階段。
text.en: Qisda has electronics and diversified operations, while financing for a property subsidiary's construction is separate from commissioning a production line.

text.zh: 公開資訊觀測站轉載公告與中央社報導均列出 1,000 萬美元及 100% 持股。未列示這筆投入資金的各期付款時程。
text.en: The reproduced material filing and CNA report agree on US$10 million and 100% ownership. They provide no construction payment schedule.

text.en: Site, construction scope, completion date and any server or semiconductor production linkage remain undisclosed.
